verdict.rationale: ROCm's own docs present a documented inference path, with vLLM and SGLang recipes, on a platform optimized for AMD Instinct GPUs, and the MI325X appears in the ROCm GPU spec table as gfx942. That establishes a vendor-documented serving stack for this part. However, nothing in the pack documents FP8 or FP4 low-precision support, and the recipes are not shown to be MI325X-specific. missing for 10: documented FP8/FP4 format support on MI325X, MI325X-specific inference recipes or benchmarks, evidence for llama.cpp, independent or hands-on corroboration of the serving stack working on this part.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, this GPU has a documented LLM inference story — low-precision formats (FP8/FP4) and supported serving stacks (TensorRT-LLM, vLLM, ROCm, llama.cpp) for this part
